english_proficiency_and_rhet1020.value: CEFR B2 required for English-taught courses (referenced ~TOEFL 80 / IELTS 6.5 in UC3M English Proficiency Letter Template). No formal certificate upload is required by UC3M — partner home institution guarantees nominees hold B2 level. RHET 1020 waiver policy not mentioned.
english_proficiency_and_rhet1020.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Universidad Carlos III de Madrid (UC3M)/UC3M Materials/1. UC3M Fact Sheet 2026_2027.pdf#page=4

host_language_requirement.value: CEFR B2 in Spanish (for Spanish-taught courses) or CEFR B2 in English (for English-taught courses), certified/guaranteed by home partner university; C1 Spanish required for 'Spanish' Digital Humanities course.
host_language_requirement.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Universidad Carlos III de Madrid (UC3M)/UC3M Materials/1. UC3M Fact Sheet 2026_2027.pdf#page=4
host_language_requirement.notes: Digital Humanities C1 rule on data/raw/factsheets/Universidad Carlos III de Madrid (UC3M)/UC3M Materials/2. Course+Offer+Guide26-27.pdf#page=4.

fall_term_dates.value: 2026-27 Fall Semester: Welcome Event Sep 4, 2026; Courses Sep 7 - Dec 11, 2026; Anticipated exams for Fall-only exchange students Dec 16-22, 2026 (Full-year students sit Fall exams Jan 11-25, 2027).
fall_term_dates.notes: Early vs Jan exam split explained in data/raw/factsheets/Universidad Carlos III de Madrid (UC3M)/UC3M Materials/1. UC3M Fact Sheet 2026_2027.pdf#page=4; calendar portal https://www.uc3m.es/bachelor-degree/practical-information/calendar-schedules.

spring_term_dates.value: 2026-27 Spring Semester: Welcome Event Jan 22, 2027; Courses Jan 26 - May 7, 2027; Exam period May 11-28, 2027; Extraordinary retakes Jun 14-30, 2027.

tuition_model.notes: Official UC3M exchange rules confirm tuition fee waiver for partner exchange students; optional Spanish Language Center courses carry an independent registration fee (Fact Sheet p.4 / Course Guide p.10).

est_monthly_living_local.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Universidad Carlos III de Madrid (UC3M)/UC3M Materials/1. UC3M Fact Sheet 2026_2027.pdf#page=7
est_monthly_living_local.notes: UC3M Fact Sheet 2026-27 p.7 explicitly states: 'Living expenses in Madrid (including sharing an apartment, food and transportation) would be around 700/800 EUR/month.'

living_cost_usd_est.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Universidad Carlos III de Madrid (UC3M)/UC3M Materials/1. UC3M Fact Sheet 2026_2027.pdf#page=7
living_cost_usd_est.notes: Midpoint EUR 750.00/month (700-800 EUR/month) * 5 months = EUR 3,750.00; converted at ECB 2026-11-13 rate (collected 2026-11-15) 1 EUR = 1.1052 USD (https://www.ecb.europa.eu/stats/policy_and_exchange_rates/euro_reference_exchange_rates/html/index.en.html) = 4,144.50 USD.

mandatory_host_fees_and_insurance.value: Tuition waived for exchange students. UC3M does not provide health insurance; incoming exchange students must arrange comprehensive travel/illness/accident insurance covering repatriation expenses due to illness or accident (Fact Sheet p.6).
mandatory_host_fees_and_insurance.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Universidad Carlos III de Madrid (UC3M)/UC3M Materials/1. UC3M Fact Sheet 2026_2027.pdf#page=6

housing_availability.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Universidad Carlos III de Madrid (UC3M)/UC3M Materials/4. HousingOptionsPartners.pdf#page=1
housing_availability.notes: UC3M Residence Halls (2 in Getafe, 1 in Leganes — semester students increasingly accommodated), plus partnered private student residences (LIV Student, MiCampus, Amro, Vivocoliving) and housing agencies.

housing_notes.value: Options include UC3M Residence Halls (2 Getafe, 1 Leganes), partner residences (Getafe: LIV Student, MiCampus, Amro, Vivocoliving; Leganes: MiCampus), and verified housing agencies. Secure housing prior to arrival (Fact Sheet p.7).
housing_notes.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Universidad Carlos III de Madrid (UC3M)/UC3M Materials/4. HousingOptionsPartners.pdf#page=1
housing_notes.notes: Rental scam warning and Living in Madrid guide on data/raw/factsheets/Universidad Carlos III de Madrid (UC3M)/UC3M Materials/1. UC3M Fact Sheet 2026_2027.pdf#page=7.

visa_lead_time_and_financial_proof.value: Non-EU students receive a SIGMA Acceptance Letter to apply for a Spanish student visa at a Spanish embassy/consulate; must upload passport, visa, and insurance docs to SIGMA by Jul 20 (Fall/FY) or Jan 24 (Spring). Stays >6 months require a Foreigner's Identity Card (TIE) within 1 month of arrival. Spanish visa economic proof uses IPREM benchmark (~EUR 600/month * months of stay).
visa_lead_time_and_financial_proof.notes: Admission SIGMA upload workflow on data/raw/factsheets/Universidad Carlos III de Madrid (UC3M)/UC3M Materials/1. UC3M Fact Sheet 2026_2027.pdf#page=3.

course_catalog_url.notes: School degree links in data/raw/factsheets/Universidad Carlos III de Madrid (UC3M)/UC3M Materials/2. Course+Offer+Guide26-27.pdf#page=4.

credit_system_and_load.value: ECTS credit system: minimum 6 ECTS (1 course) and maximum 30 ECTS per semester (60 ECTS per full academic year); max 3 Humanities/Cross-curricula short courses.
credit_system_and_load.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Universidad Carlos III de Madrid (UC3M)/UC3M Materials/2. Course+Offer+Guide26-27.pdf#page=5
credit_system_and_load.notes: Also stated in data/raw/factsheets/Universidad Carlos III de Madrid (UC3M)/UC3M Materials/1. UC3M Fact Sheet 2026_2027.pdf#page=5-6.

course_restrictions_note.value: Non-European exchange students may enroll in courses across ALL UC3M schools (unlike Erasmus+, restricted to admitted school). Course enrollment is first-come, first-served with high-demand caps (plan backups). Distance exams are not allowed.
course_restrictions_note.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Universidad Carlos III de Madrid (UC3M)/UC3M Materials/1. UC3M Fact Sheet 2026_2027.pdf#page=5
course_restrictions_note.notes: Full list of restricted/excluded degrees on data/raw/factsheets/Universidad Carlos III de Madrid (UC3M)/UC3M Materials/2. Course+Offer+Guide26-27.pdf#page=4-5; no-distance-exam rule on data/raw/factsheets/Universidad Carlos III de Madrid (UC3M)/UC3M Materials/1. UC3M Fact Sheet 2026_2027.pdf#page=4.

value: No separate online application form required post-nomination; upon admission email upload passport, visa, and health insurance documents via SIGMA
required_application_docs.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Universidad Carlos III de Madrid (UC3M)/UC3M Materials/1. UC3M Fact Sheet 2026_2027.pdf#page=3

academic_style.value: Continuous assessment plus mandatory on-site final exams combining lecture and small practical/seminar sessions across 4 campuses; Fall semester exchange-only students take anticipated finals in December before Christmas.
academic_style.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Universidad Carlos III de Madrid (UC3M)/UC3M Materials/1. UC3M Fact Sheet 2026_2027.pdf#page=4
academic_style.notes: Lecture/practicum split in data/raw/factsheets/Universidad Carlos III de Madrid (UC3M)/UC3M Materials/2. Course+Offer+Guide26-27.pdf#page=9.

campus_type.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Universidad Carlos III de Madrid (UC3M)/UC3M Materials/1. UC3M Fact Sheet 2026_2027.pdf#page=1
campus_type.notes: Four campuses in Madrid region: Getafe (Social Sciences/Law/Humanities/Health), Leganes (Engineering), Colmenarejo, and Puerta de Toledo.

international_support_services.value: No airport pickup; Buddy program, Welcome Days, ESN UC3M, Student Support Center, psychological orientation in English & Spanish, special-needs support (register before Jul 15 Fall / Dec 15 Spring), and fee-paying Language Center Spanish courses.
international_support_services.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Universidad Carlos III de Madrid (UC3M)/UC3M Materials/1. UC3M Fact Sheet 2026_2027.pdf#page=6
international_support_services.notes: No-pickup & Buddy/Support/Special-Needs on data/raw/factsheets/Universidad Carlos III de Madrid (UC3M)/UC3M Materials/1. UC3M Fact Sheet 2026_2027.pdf#page=4,6,7.

nomination_deadlines.value: 2026-27 Non-European Mobility (MNE) nominations: Feb 20 - May 5, 2026 (Fall/FY) and Sep 1 - Oct 30, 2026 (Spring). Post-admission SIGMA document uploads due Jul 20 (Fall/FY) and Jan 24 (Spring).
nomination_deadlines.notes: Erasmus+ nomination windows: Mar 13 - May 15, 2026 (Fall/FY) and Sep 15 - Oct 16, 2026 (Spring).
